```{.quiz-yaml}
id: 13_related_t_pairs
title: What could we still work out without the pairs?
questions:
  - id: lost_pairs
    type: multiple-choice
    prompt: >
      Suppose we kept all five alone times and all five competition times,
      but lost the names and mixed up the order of the rows in each column.
      Which of these could we still work out?
    options:
      - text: How many children were faster in competition.
      - text: The difference between the two condition means.
        correct: true
      - text: How much each child's time changed.
    explanation: >
      The two columns still contain the same times, so their means haven't
      changed. But without knowing which times belong to the same child,
      we can't work out each child's change, or how many children improved.
      The rows tell us something that the two separate lists don't. Losing
      track of the pairs doesn't make the original scores independent.
```
